mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5 percentage points, it indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate falls below 3.5% but the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of such instances, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor market is strong (PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly) and inflation is elevated (CPIAUCSL above 3.5% annually), the central bank is likely to maintain restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) occurs but the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate profit margins and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.0, it signals robust manufacturing activity and economic strength, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO exceeds 105.0 but the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of such instances, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) are above their 12-month moving averages, it indicates a synchronized expansion in the real economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (GDPC1 and INDPRO both above 12-month MA) occurs but the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a strong labor market (PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly) supports corporate hiring and profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.
